criterion_source_semantics: Scientific K1-K9 definitions are inherited unchanged by V6.
change_record_owner: W12 under human approval per V6
freeze_note: This artifact copies the pre-existing K1-K9 operational criteria from the active V6 plan without modification. W03-W09 evidence inventory/reconciliation occurred before this freeze, but no K1-K9 verdict classification is performed here.

criteria.scientific_question: Does a comparable continuum layer-jamming model already map its validity domain?
criteria.test_scope: Vacuum or mechanically equivalent layered-beam continuum/reduced models.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: Same reduced mechanics question and comparable interface/layer interaction, even with different terminology.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Full text maps accepted and breakdown regimes for an equivalent continuum layer-jamming model using a declared domain and quantitative comparison.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Equivalent model and applicability study exist, but domain, output, uncertainty or breakdown mapping is incomplete.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Model description, qualitative applicability statement, or generic validation without a domain map.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Full text or model meaning is unavailable or cannot distinguish validity mapping from ordinary case validation.
criteria.required_evidence: Model equations/assumptions, operating domain, validity criterion, breakdown evidence and source locators.
criteria.minimum_evidence_quality: VERIFIED_FULL_TEXT for direct or partial classification.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary; canonical JSON controls current repository state.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: Named K1 gap after repository screening or inaccessible high-threat source.
criteria.adjudication_notes: Pre-execution placeholder; execution must replace the verdict with an allowed final state.

criteria.scientific_question: Does prior work compare a reduced model with a layer-resolved or full-contact reference over a meaningful domain?
criteria.test_scope: Reduced/continuum versus interface-resolved, discrete-layer or frictional-contact reference.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: The reference must resolve interface/layer physics relevant to the proposed reduced-model limitation, regardless of software name.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Prior full text compares an equivalent reduced model and higher-fidelity reference across pressure, layer count, loading or equivalent dimensions with quantitative outputs.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Comparison exists but lacks meaningful domain breadth, interface resolution, shared outputs or independent verification.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Two models are merely mentioned, or a high-fidelity model is used without reduced-model comparison.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Reference resolution or shared output cannot be verified.
criteria.required_evidence: Both model formulations, interface resolution, domain, shared outputs, quantitative comparison and locators.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: K2 comparison fields remain missing for a named threat.
criteria.human_review_trigger: Any claim that a different model is conceptually equivalent.

criteria.scientific_question: Is comparable model-form error already quantified for the same or equivalent mechanics problem?
criteria.test_scope: Error attributable to model form rather than calibration, parameter fitting or measurement noise.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: Error decomposition and output definition must answer the same reduced-model validity question.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Full text isolates and quantifies output-specific model-form error against a higher-fidelity or independently justified reference over a declared domain.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Quantitative error exists but model-form isolation, output specificity, domain or uncertainty is incomplete.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Generic percentage error, fit quality or calibration residual without model-form identification.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: The paper does not permit separation of model-form error from calibration or measurement error.
criteria.required_evidence: Error definition, reference, parameter treatment, uncertainty, domain, numerical values and locators.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.existing_repository_sources: D1-V001..D1-V009, evidence packets and canonical matrices.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: A named error-comparison threat lacks full-text resolution.

criteria.scientific_question: Were valid and invalid/breakdown regimes deliberately identified before final outcomes were observed?
criteria.test_scope: Predeclared regime classification and deliberate sampling of both regimes.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: A regime map counts only when classification is tied to an explicit criterion, not retrospective narrative.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Prior work predeclares valid/breakdown criteria and deliberately tests both sides over a meaningful operating domain.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Two regimes are discussed, but one side is absent, criteria are incomplete, or the boundary is retrospective.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Single-regime validation or qualitative failure report without a declared boundary.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Timing of criteria or regime selection cannot be established.
criteria.required_evidence: Predeclared criterion, sampling plan/domain, results on both sides, timing and uncertainty.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: Regime-boundary timing or two-sided testing is unresolved.

criteria.scientific_question: Did an independent experiment deliberately sample both sides of a predicted validity boundary?
criteria.test_scope: Experiment independent of model calibration and spanning predicted accepted and breakdown regimes.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: Both sides requires a boundary predicted before final validation data are inspected and a shared measurable output.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Prior study predicts a boundary, freezes the criterion, and independently measures the same output on both sides with uncertainty.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Independent experiment exists but samples only one side, uses a post-hoc boundary, or lacks shared-output/uncertainty evidence.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Experiment validates isolated points or tests a different question without boundary sampling.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Independence, prediction timing or side-of-boundary classification cannot be verified.
criteria.required_evidence: Prediction timing, experimental design, shared output, both-side samples, uncertainty and locators.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.human_review_trigger: Independence or post-hoc-boundary dispute, KILL or UNRESOLVED.

criteria.scientific_question: Is reduced-model failure mechanistically attributed to contact, slip, separation or related interface physics?
criteria.test_scope: Local interface/contact evidence connected to model discrepancy.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: The mechanism must be relevant to the same interface physics, not merely share a word such as slip.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Prior work links discrepancy to locally evidenced contact, slip, separation or pressure-redistribution behavior with a defensible causal chain.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Mechanism is discussed or consistently correlated but lacks local evidence or causal discrimination.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Pressure/error or slip/error correlation alone, or a generic mechanism assertion.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Mechanism evidence is inaccessible, contradictory or only inferential.
criteria.required_evidence: Local mechanism observation/field, discrepancy linkage, alternative explanations and locators.
criteria.minimum_evidence_quality: VERIFIED_FULL_TEXT; causal claims require stronger evidence than correlation.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: Mechanism attribution is named as a surviving claim but not resolved.

criteria.scientific_question: Has an equivalent M → R → E workflow already been applied to vacuum layer-jamming beams?
criteria.test_scope: Vacuum layer-jamming beam studies using a specified reduced model, higher-fidelity reference and independent experiment.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: Terminology may differ, but all three roles and the same validity/breakdown question must be substantively present.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: One paper or defensible paper chain performs the equivalent M→R→E workflow for vacuum layer-jamming beams and evaluates validity/breakdown.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Two roles or an adjacent application are equivalent, but the complete workflow or scientific question is incomplete.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Generic model validation or separate experiments without M→R→E structure.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: One role or conceptual equivalence cannot be verified from full text.
criteria.required_evidence: Role mapping for M, R and E, beam/vacuum context, validity question, outputs and locators.
criteria.minimum_evidence_quality: VERIFIED_FULL_TEXT for direct kill; adjacent evidence may only support partial overlap.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.existing_repository_sources: D1-V001..D1-V009, named-target audits and paper packets.

criteria.scientific_question: Does prior methodology make D1 routine rather than scientifically substantive?
criteria.test_scope: Whether the proposed combination adds a new mechanics question beyond ordinary validation workflow.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: A method is equivalent only when it resolves the same scientific validity/breakdown question, not merely uses the same tools.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Prior methodology already supplies the same substantive mechanics question, evidence structure and decision logic, leaving only routine implementation.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Prior methodology makes much of the workflow routine but leaves a distinct unresolved mechanics question or interface regime.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Prior work shares ordinary methods but not the same scientific question or falsifiable boundary.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Scientific contribution cannot be separated from workflow sophistication using available evidence.
criteria.required_evidence: Prior method purpose, scientific question, model/reference/experiment roles, decision logic and contribution limits.
criteria.minimum_evidence_quality: VERIFIED_FULL_TEXT plus Sol synthesis; absence alone cannot yield a kill.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: Candidate remains supported only by method combination.

criteria.scientific_question: Does conceptually equivalent work under different terminology directly pre-empt D1?
criteria.test_scope: Adjacent mechanics terminology including composite/partial-interaction, homogenized, reduced-order, interface-contact, slip and applicability studies.
criteria.conceptual_equivalence_rule: Structural mechanics question and evidence chain control equivalence; exact title or keyword match is unnecessary.
criteria.DIRECT_KILL_CRITERION: Different terminology hides a study that substantively answers the same surviving D1 question with comparable model, reference, domain, boundary and evidence.
criteria.PARTIAL_OVERLAP_CRITERION: Adjacent study covers material components of D1 but leaves a distinct vacuum/layer-jamming or boundary-crossing question.
criteria.NO_KILL_CRITERION: Superficial terminology, different mechanics question or generic analogy without the required evidence chain.
criteria.UNRESOLVED_CRITERION: Terminology translation or full-text meaning remains ambiguous.
criteria.required_evidence: Synonym map, model/question mapping, domain, outputs, evidence status and locators.
criteria.minimum_evidence_quality: VERIFIED_FULL_TEXT for direct equivalence; metadata can only nominate a source.
criteria.source_precedence: Original PDF > evidence JSON > AI summary.
criteria.targeted_search_trigger: Current-title search is insufficient for a named K9 threat.
